introduction: Legal Services of North Dakota accepts applications for free civil legal help online or by telephone. Describe any court date at the start of intake.
description: Legal Services of North Dakota accepts applications for free civil legal help online or by telephone. Describe any court date at the start of intake.

sections.who: The provider screens financial circumstances and the North Dakota legal issue. Its intake routes distinguish applicants under 60 from older applicants.
sections.get: Staff assess whether legal information, advice or representation is available for the issue.
sections.docs:
• Contact information and a safe way to reach you.
  • Court papers, notices and relevant dates.
  • Household finances requested during intake.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use LSND’s application link. Phone intake is Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m. Central.

  2. Use the appropriate number

    Applicants under 60 can call 800-634-5263; people 60 or older can call 866-621-9886.

  3. Explain the issue

    Identify the other parties and provide requested papers. Ask what to do before any approaching court date.
sections.after: Keep copies of correspondence and clarify whether a lawyer has agreed to represent you. An application alone does not establish representation.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using LSND services and intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: LSND describes its qualifying legal assistance as free.
Yes. The provider’s website links its current application system.
Should I wait if a court date is near?
Tell intake staff about the date immediately and follow the court’s instructions while your request is assessed.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
